content.overview: Section 15 charges salary due, paid, or allowed, whether from an employer in India or, in the stated cases, outside India.
content.glance: Section 15 charges salary due, paid, or allowed, whether from an employer in India or, in the stated cases, outside India.
content.study: Income chargeable under the head Salaries is salary due from an employer or a former employer, whether paid or not, advance salary, and arrears, if not already charged.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 15 charges salary due, paid, or allowed, whether from an employer in India or, in the stated cases, outside India.

examples.title: Application of ita-s-15
examples.body: Facts that satisfy the elements stated in the provision produce the consequence described in the text.

hypotheticals.question: Do the facts engage ita-s-15?
hypotheticals.analysis: Compare the facts with the statutory elements stated in the text.

examTips: State the section and the operative rule. Verify the enacted heading before formal citation.

distinctions.title: Scope of ita-s-15
distinctions.body: Applies only within the elements and consequences stated in the statutory text.

misconceptions.myth: ita-s-15 creates unlimited or extra-statutory rights.
misconceptions.correction: It operates only as stated in the provision.
